lines.en: I come forward without touching the floor.
As I near, the light retreats.
I am not fast, but I do not stop.
I walk the length of the wall.
Each step is nearer than the last.

lines.zh: 我的影子先把门堵住了。
lines.en: My shadow blocks the door first.

lines.zh: 我路过的地方温度降了。
lines.en: The temperature drops where I pass.
My steps give no sense of distance.
I come from the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都枯了。
lines.en: The grass withers where I walk.

lines.zh: 我转身时，声音慢了半拍。
lines.en: When I turn, the sound lags.

lines.zh: 我立着，像一根没法测量的杆。
lines.en: I stand like a post that cannot be measured.
I watch you without blinking.
My outline is fainter than the air.
I do not so much as lift a finger.
I wait for your patience to run out.
The lamp is weaker beside me.
I tilt, then straighten.
There is no echo in this room.
I neither eat nor rest.

lines.zh: 我想起过什么，然后忘了。
lines.en: I remembered something, then forgot it.
My fingers hang and do not move.
The air carries an old smell.
You see me; that is enough.

lines.zh: 你的希望，比刚才少了一点。
lines.en: There is a little less hope in you than before.
The longer you hold, the less you can hold.
I watch your grip tighten and loosen.

lines.zh: 你的手在找一个放的地方。
lines.en: Your hands are looking for somewhere to rest.
I am harder to deal with than the last one.
No need to look elsewhere; only I am here.
I am one arm's length away.
You press your back to the wall.
You mean to speak and swallow it.
I wait for you to give up.

lines.zh: 你数着时间，时间不帮你。
lines.en: You count the time; time does not help you.
I am not hurried; I have all the night.
I do not need your name.

lines.zh: 我出现在你希望最多的时候。
lines.en: I appear when your hope is highest.
You look back; I am always there.
Your shoulders have dropped.
That's it; stop holding on.
You hit me and I grow fainter.
I have no blood, only a gap.
That slowed me by a beat.

lines.zh: 你越用力，越像打在冷里。
lines.en: The harder you strike, the colder it feels.
My shape wavers.
You knocked a piece off me.
I retreat, very slowly.
This body does not belong here.
You have a few more blows in you.
You have not made me stop.

lines.zh: 你想要的东西，我也想要。
lines.en: What you want, I want too.
Give it to me and you have one less thing to hold.
Keeping it will only tire you more.
It trembles in your hand.
I extend one hand, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你不必放手，我也可以等。
lines.en: You need not let go; I can wait.

lines.zh: 这东西上面全是你的气。
lines.en: This thing is covered in your breath.
I touch it once and it goes cold.
Put it down and we continue.
You walk into my arms.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你的力气少了一半。
lines.en: At that touch, half your strength is gone.
You fall back; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有温度交换。
lines.en: No warmth passes between us.
My body is heavier than the wall.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，声音闷得没有回响。
lines.en: You hit me, and the sound has no echo.
Your hand passes through my sleeve.
You should not have touched me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，你的呼吸乱了。
lines.en: I press close and your breathing breaks.
When you retreat, I fill the space.

lines.zh: 这是一个没有尽头的地方。
lines.en: This is a place without an end.
I do not come in twos; I am what remains of one.

lines.zh: 你问这个，说明你还想活。
lines.en: Asking that means you still want to live.
Only waiting and endings here.

lines.zh: 我歪头，这个动作很费劲。
lines.en: I tilt my head; it costs me effort.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己是怎么来的。
lines.en: I do not remember how I came to be.
Holding such thoughts will wear you out.
I have nothing to give.
I turn my face away and my outline fades.
Let that subject end here.
I pick it up; it is very light.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，它就不再是你的了。
lines.en: Holding it, it is no longer yours.

lines.zh: 我把它放在门边，让你看见。
lines.en: I set it by the door so you can see it.
It cools slowly in my hand.

lines.zh: 我看它的时候，你在看我。
lines.en: While I look at it, you look at me.
I drop it and it makes no sound.

lines.zh: 这件东西你昨天还握着。
lines.en: You were holding this yesterday.

lines.zh: 我把它折了一下，折不动。
lines.en: I try to bend it; it will not bend.

lines.zh: 我把它收进袖子，袖子没有形。
lines.en: I put it in my sleeve; the sleeve has no shape.
Looking for it will tire you further.
You are already here.
I see where you are.
You back into the corner; I am not surprised.
The bricks under me begin to sound.
The life in you is faint.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的出口只剩我
lines.en: The only way out of this room is through me.
I have taken you into my sight.
This will not take long.

lines.zh: 我什么都看得见，也什么都做。
lines.en: I see all, and I do worse.
Your shadow gave up first.

lines.zh: 你走的每一步都是我留的。
lines.en: Every step you take, I left for you.
I do not shout; shouting is pointless.
Stop searching; I am right here.

lines.zh: 你的退路被你自己堵住了。
lines.en: You have blocked your own way out.
Good; let it end here.
I follow you, without haste.

lines.zh: 你跑过走廊，走廊变长了。
lines.en: You run the corridor, and it lengthens.
You stop behind the door; so do I.

lines.zh: 你听见的动静，是我给的。
lines.en: What you hear, I gave you.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙里，一直与你同侧。
lines.en: I move inside the wall, always parallel.
You counted to ten; I closed two steps.
Your breathing is breaking.

lines.zh: 我看着你换方向，第三次了。
lines.en: I watch you change direction; the third time.

lines.zh: 你在找出口，出口不在这儿。
lines.en: You are looking for a way out; it is not here.

lines.zh: 我停下，让你以为有机会。
lines.en: I stop, so you think you have a chance.
That light is nearly out.
The wall beside you must be cold.

lines.zh: 你开始听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: You are starting to hear your own heart.
I am done hiding.
You turn round, and there I am.

lines.zh: 这间屋子没有第二个门。
lines.en: This room has no second door.
Your hand is flat on the wall.
At last you have stopped.
I have touched your shadow.
My hand settles on your throat.
I am in no hurry; I press slowly.

lines.zh: 我按下去，一点声都没有。
lines.en: I press down without a sound.
Your knees bend first.

lines.zh: 你打回来，手却抬不起来。
lines.en: You strike back, but your hand will not lift.

lines.zh: 我贴在你耳边，什么也没说。
lines.en: I lean to your ear and say nothing.

lines.zh: 你的力气顺着我的手指走了。
lines.en: Your strength leaves through my fingers.
You kneel, and I barely pressed.
I step back a little and watch you.
You have a little strength left; use it.

lines.zh: 你倒在地板上，声音很轻。
lines.en: You fall to the floor; the sound is slight.

lines.zh: 这一下比上一个更疼，对吧。
lines.en: That hurt more than the last one, didn't it.
Your eyes are searching for the door.

lines.zh: 我把你按住，等你不再动。
lines.en: I hold you down until you stop moving.

lines.zh: 我出现的地方，光先暗了。
lines.en: The light dims before I appear.
I arrived without footsteps.

lines.zh: 这间屋子比看上去更小。
lines.en: This room is smaller than it looks.
You hear the air change.
I grow out of the corner.

lines.zh: 一开始只是一个模糊的形。
lines.en: At first I am only a blurred shape.
I block the door.
The temperature here has dropped three degrees.
The lamp in your hand shakes.

lines.zh: 我能感到你在期待什么。
lines.en: I can feel you hoping for something.

lines.zh: 那就是我最喜欢的时刻。
lines.en: That is my favorite moment.

lines.zh: 你周围的东西都很安静。
lines.en: Everything around you is very still.
I begin to move, very slowly.
I have been here a long time already.
Only one direction is left in this room.

lines.zh: 你转身找我，我就在你身后。
lines.en: You turn to find me, and I am behind you.
I will not speak yet.
I will let you walk over yourself.

lines.zh: 火光照过来，我薄了一层。
lines.en: The firelight thins me by a layer.

lines.zh: 我落下去，落得没有声音。
lines.en: I fall, and land silently.
Water passes through me as pure cold.
After the blast, I am still standing.

lines.zh: 箭从你手里出发，穿过了我。
lines.en: The arrow leaves your hand and passes through me.
The spell-light makes me retreat an inch.
I do not eat; there is only less of me.

lines.zh: 那一瞬，我被照得很清楚。
lines.en: For a moment I am lit up plainly.
I fell away, and the outline remains.
